testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the extrusion row context menu: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:41:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the extrusion row context menu ✔ Given an active part in the MCAD Software contains a block created by an extrusion ✔ And the extrusion row is visible in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the extrusion row ✔ Then the row is highlighted and the block edges are highlighted in blue ✔ And the context menu offers Edit Sketch and Edit Feature ✔ And the context menu offers Show Dimensions, Measure and Properties ✔ And the context menu offers Expand All Children and collapses All Children ✔ When the user dismisses the menu and clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the context menu and blue edge highlighting disappear ✔ And the block remains visible
